example.prompt: The young woman in a cozy striped sweater and chunky knit scarf stands by a tranquil misty lake at golden hour, facing the camera. She holds the same quiet position throughout, while a complex apologetic expression slowly reveals itself across her face: her gaze drops from meeting the lens toward the lower right corner of the frame, her eyelids lower halfway, her lips press together for a beat and then part slightly as if starting to apologise, the inner corners of her brows lift by a fraction forming a faint crease above the bridge of her nose, then her chin tucks in a touch and she swallows once. None of these motions are large; only her face moves. Her body, shoulders and the surrounding dusk lake with distant misty mountains stay essentially still — the only other motion in the frame is a few loose strands of her short dark hair drifting slowly across her cheek in a still breeze. The camera does not move. The shot is a held close-up to mid of her face and upper body, soft warm golden-hour lighting, photorealistic, shallow depth of field, 24fps.
